image_description: A close-up view of a silver-colored metal breastplate (cuirass) displayed on a black mannequin torso. The armor features intricate vertical embossed patterns, a central raised ridge, and a horizontal slit near the top. It has a polished, reflective surface with visible light reflections indicating its metallic nature. The bottom edge shows attachment points for lower armor components (faulds).

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar objects like plastrons or decorative vests.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections and ensure no texture smearing or AI-generated noise in the polished areas.
To verify the sharpness of the cut edges and ensure the embossed patterns do not bleed into the background or distort unnaturally.
To confirm that the embossed details have valid 3D depth and cast appropriate micro-shadows, rather than being flat textures.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness against the mannequin background
Structural plausibility of the central ridge and curves
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embossed patterns: do they maintain consistent perspective and depth across the curved surface? Check for any 'melting' of the metal texture near the edges or the horizontal slit. Verify if the reflection logic on the curved surface is physically consistent with a single light source.
